body.purpose: Form labels, table cells, dl/dt-dd detail pairs, button labels.

headline.purpose: One per page, in the layout header slot.

seccion.purpose: A card's own discreet uppercase heading (.titulo-seccion) where the card's content should outweigh its title — e.g. Resumen del Recibo, Pagos.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Reserved for surfaces that must float above a raised card.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single highest-priority action on a screen (Guardar, Nueva Locación).
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; padding: .375rem .75rem; font-size: 1rem; border-radius: .375rem; border: 1px solid transparent; transition: color .15s ease-in-out, background-color .15s ease-in-out, border-color .15s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-primary { background-color: #1e40af; border-color: #1e40af; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #1a3696; border-color: #18327d; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 .25rem rgba(30,64,175,.35); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action, always paired with an outline-secondary cancel sibling inside a confirmation modal.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background-color: #991b1b; border-color: #991b1b; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background-color: #7d1616; border-color: #711414; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 .25rem rgba(153,27,27,.35); }

components.name: Outline Secondary Button
components.description: Default for every non-primary, non-destructive action (Editar, Cancelar, Ver Historial).
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background-color: transparent; border-color: #374151; color: #374151; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background-color: #374151; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 .25rem rgba(55,65,81,.3); }

components.name: Card
components.description: The single elevated surface in the system; resting shadow at rest, raised shadow on hover.
components.html:
Costos Fijos de Referencia

Déjelo en blanco si no aplica; se registrará como S/ 0.00.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: .375rem; box-shadow: 0 .125rem .375rem rgba(17,24,39,.08); transition: box-shadow .15s ease-in-out; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 .375rem 1rem rgba(17,24,39,.1); } .ds-card-body { padding: 1.05rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.05rem; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; margin: 0; }

components.name: Semantic Badge
components.description: Status indicator (pagado/pendiente/anulado, alquilable/no alquilable) — always paired with an explicit text label, color is reinforcement not the only signal.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; padding: .35em .65em; font-size: .75em; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; color: #fff; border-radius: 50rem; } .ds-badge-success { background-color: #166534; } .ds-badge-danger { background-color: #991b1b; } .ds-badge-secondary { background-color: #374151; }

components.name: Currency Input
components.description: Every monetary field is prefixed with a literal S/ so the currency is never ambiguous.
components.html: S/
components.css: .ds-input-group { display: flex; align-items: stretch; } .ds-input-prefix { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: .375rem .75rem; background: #e9ecef; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-right: 0; border-radius: .375rem 0 0 .375rem; color: #111827; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-input { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; padding: .375rem .75rem; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 0 .375rem .375rem 0; font-size: 1rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 0; border-color: #1e40af; box-shadow: 0 0 0 .25rem rgba(30,64,175,.25); }

components.name: Estado Vacío
components.description: Signature empty-state pattern: dashed border, no shadow, no white fill — deliberately reads as 'nothing here yet', not as a card.
components.css: .ds-estado-vacio { text-align: center; color: #374151; padding: 1.8375rem 1.05rem; border: 1px dashed #d1d5db; border-radius: .375rem; } .ds-estado-vacio-icon { font-size: 1.75rem; color: #374151; display: block; margin-bottom: .525rem; font-style: normal; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Link
components.description: Inactive: white on dark, no fill. Hover: soft 10% white fill. Active: Signature Teal fill — the accent's only home in the system.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; padding: .5rem .75rem; border-radius: .375rem; color: #fff; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color .15s ease-in-out; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { background-color: rgba(255,255,255,.1); } .ds-nav-link-active { background-color: #0e7490; }

narrative.overview: Rent Tracker is the back office for someone who manages rental properties, contracts, tenants, deposits and monthly receipts by hand today and needs a screen that never makes them double-check whether an amount, a date or a contract's status is what it says it is. This is Operate-mode software: the visitor completes a task, so scanability, consistency and native Bootstrap conventions outrank expressive flourish. The system is built on stock Bootstrap 5.3 with a deliberately narrow set of overrides: a higher-contrast semantic palette, a slightly more generous spacing scale, soft card elevation, and one signature accent color reserved for state.
keyCharacteristics: Semantic color first: every status is read from color + icon + text together, never color alone.
One accent, used rarely: the signature teal marks 'this is the active navigation item,' nothing else.
Money is typeset, not just formatted: monetary and metered figures use tabular numerals.
Every destructive action stops for a named confirmation, never a bare 'OK.'

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The signature teal marks current location, never an action. A second element wanting the accent should be Deep Cobalt (action) or a semantic color (state) instead.

rules.name: The No-Decoration Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from Bootstrap's stock weight/size steps alone — never letter-spacing tricks, all-caps labels, or a second display face.

rules.name: The Response-Not-Rest Rule
rules.body: Elevation increases only in response to interaction (hover). A card never ships at its raised shadow by default.

dos: Do keep every component a stock Bootstrap primitive per the constitution's Principio VI.
Do pair every status badge and alert with both a semantic color and an icon.
Do require a named, two-button confirmation for every destructive action.
Do apply tabular numerals to monetary and metered figures wherever numbers need to align in a column.
Do keep the Signature Teal accent to exactly one job: marking current location in the sidebar.
donts: Don't introduce Alpine.js for write-interactivity — htmx (hx-boost) is the documented, binding choice.
Don't nest a card inside a card, or box an already-bordered empty state.
Don't use gradient text, hard offset shadows, or a kicker/eyebrow above a heading.
Don't substitute an icon for a text label.
Don't widen Bootstrap's stock control sizing by default.
